assetUse: Character-specific fallback combat sprite for attack dice without an authored skill sprite. Equipped weapons use their original art and HoldPoint.
gripConvention: Normalized sprite coordinates with origin at the bottom left. Rotation is in degrees about the sprite's local Z axis.
